# Jianhao Travel Planner , full trip roadbook workflow with on-the-ground verification

Curated by Skill Harbor: a full trip-planning workflow forged through real trips and honest failure logs: intake, destination filtering, live verification of every key fact (prices, hours, tickets, never answer from memory), a six-dimension roadbook (eat, play, stay, go, shoot, plus pitfalls), dynamic adjustments mid-trip, and a review loop that writes lessons back into the standards. The version history alone, with its dated "what went wrong" entries, is worth reading. by @awangwang123, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the skill content is in Chinese and built around Chinese travel sources (Dianping, Amap, Xiaohongshu), so it works best for China domestic trips; international coverage is still being tested. A free Pexels key (2-minute self-registration) is needed for the image workflow. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via GitHub.
